mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and 63 degrees at Verona City Hall, with an air quality index of 64.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for local students to help shape our November election. You can vote for your favorite designs from each grade category online through August 7, or stop by City Hall to use a paper form.

You have plenty of local options today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and dinner options like Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report on police activity, an officer responded last Saturday to a hit and run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane, resulting in a citation for the driver involved.

Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM today. If you are planning ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be the classic Caramel Turtle.
